title: Bissell mentions the 1933 Magenta crash
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Bissell mentions the 1933 Magenta crash, about 1933 at Magenta, Lombardy, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He said this didn't start last week. This has been going on. He mentioned 1933 magenta.
1933 was the first recovery in Europe in uh Magenta, Italy.
tellings.difference: Calls it the first recovery in Europe, credits Grusch and adds a Vatican back-channel under Pius XII running to 1945.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1933 crash recovery at Magenta, Italy.

as_told.title: Magenta 1933 crash recovery and Vatican back-channel

tellings.quote: According to multiple accounts, including UFO whistleblower David Grush, a disc-like object measuring roughly 10 to 12 m in diameter came down near Magenta in Lombardi, Italy in June of 1933.
tellings.difference: Gives the disc as 10-12 m across and adds a Fascist media blackout and Stefani agency telegrams.
tellings.link_reason: The same June 1933 Magenta disc crash, credited to Grusch.

as_told.title: Magenta disc crash and Fascist media blackout

tellings.quote: It was recovered in Lombardi in 1933. And uh I believe the cardinal of Milan was also of Knight of Malta at the time.
tellings.difference: Adds that the material was sent through the Vatican to the US and that the Cardinal of Milan was a Knight of Malta.
tellings.link_reason: Same 1933 Magenta, Lombardy crash retrieval that the story's Jesse Michels tellings describe, credited to Grusch.

as_told.title: The 1933 Magenta crash retrieval, sent through the Vatican to the US

tellings.quote: It probably existed prior to 1933, but it became formally instantiated in the 33 Magenta crash in Italy. This is all hypothetical in the Magenta crash in Italy and then that was transferred to the US under FDR.
tellings.difference: Adds that the object was moved to the US under FDR and calls the account hypothetical.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1933 Magenta, Italy crash recovery.

as_told.title: 1933 Magenta crash in Italy and transfer to the US under FDR

tellings.quote: and then you have you know this 1933 magenta crash which it seems like it's getting increasingly corroborated. David Grusch, Harold Malmgren both talk about it.
tellings.difference: Says the crash is increasingly corroborated and brings in the Angletons.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1933 crash recovery at Magenta, Italy, credited to Grusch and Malmgren.

tellings.quote: 1933 was the first recovery in Europe in uh Magenta, Italy. They recovered a a partially intact vehicle.
tellings.difference: Grusch tells it himself and adds that a partially intact vehicle was recovered.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the 1933 recovery at Magenta, Italy, as the first in Europe; the story already holds this exact line.

tellings.quote: Well, guess what? 1933 Magenta, Italy. I spoke to uh a man at the end of his life. His name was Harold Malmgrren who said that he was briefed by the number two in the CIA, Richard Bissell, who founded Area 51.
tellings.difference: Told by Michels, who says he spoke to Malmgren at the end of Malmgren's life and calls Bissell the CIA's number two and the founder of Area 51.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Malmgren saying Bissell told him about the 1933 Magenta crash.

as_told.title: Malmgren briefed by Richard Bissell on the Magenta crash

tellings.quote: He said this didn't start last week.
tellings.link_reason: The same line from Malmgren about Bissell's briefing ('this didn't start last week'), which the story already holds.
